description: This file defines the class `FormatWithEmployeeString` which implements the `ValueFormatter` interface. Its purpose is to return the fixed string 'Employee' regardless of the input, serving as a formatter strategy within the HRM system for formatting entity values.

classes.name: FormatWithEmployeeString
classes.description: A class implementing a value formatter that always returns the string 'Employee'.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the fixed string 'Employee' for any given input value.
